preconditions.description: The number of students n must be between 1 and 500,000.
The number of pairs of acquaintances m must be between 0 and 500,000.
The number of groups k must be between 2 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c_i <= k for c_i in c)
preconditions.description: Each student must belong to a valid group number between 1 and k.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n for a_i, b_i in acquaintances)
preconditions.description: Each acquaintance pair must consist of valid student indices between 1 and n.
The number of acquaintance pairs must match the specified m.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of valid group pairs as a string.
The count of valid group pairs must be non-negative.
The count of valid group pairs must not exceed the maximum possible pairs of groups.
